RPSC SI / Platoon Commander PET Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC) has released the PET Result for the post of Sub Inspector / Platoon Commander. This recruitment was issued for 1050 posts. The PET Exam was held on 03-13 August 2026. Online applying process for Rajasthan RPSC RPSC SI / Platoon Commander Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 10 August 2025 to 08 September 2025. Candidates can Download their RPSC SI / Platoon Commander PET Result 2026 which has given below..

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 17 July 2025
  • Application Start Date : 10 August 2025
  • Last Date : 08 September 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 08 September 2025
  • Form Correction Date: 31 January 2026 to 06 February 2026
  • Exam Date: 05, 06 April 2026
  • Exam City Details : 25 March 2026
  • Admit Card : 01 April 2026
  • Question Paper : 06 April 2026
  • Answer Key : 07 April 2026
  • Result : 19 June 2026
  • Score Card : 23 June 2026
  • Interview Letter : 08-17 July 2026
  • PET Admit Card : 29 July 2026
  • PET Exam Date : 03-13 August 2026
  • PET Result : 15 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, Other State : Rs. 600/-
  • OBC, BC : Rs. 400/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 400/-
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 500/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
